caption: The drawing depicts the interior of a large glass-domed greenhouse with an ornate central fountain as the main feature. The fountain has three tiers: the topmost is a birdcage containing several small, colorful birds; the middle and bottom tiers are circular basins with water cascading down between them and into a large pool at the base, which is surrounded by red and orange flowers in decorative pots. On either side of the fountain are tall urns overflowing with assorted flowers in shades of red, pink, purple, yellow, and blue, and surrounded by green foliage. To the left, numerous red and orange potted flowers are arranged on tiered green shelves. Tall leafy plants and ornamental grasses fill the background and edges of the scene. In the left foreground, a white, intricately carved bench in the shape of a swan faces the fountain, and beside it sits a silver watering can and small hand rake. On the right, a copper watering can and trowel lie on the ground. Another white swan-shaped bench is partially visible behind a large arrangement of flowers across from the first bench. The scene is composed with abundant greenery and floral colors set against the muted gray tones of the fountain, benches, and the geometric glass structure enclosing the space.
title: Conservatory Fountain
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
